name: Suvidhaa Infoserve Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, Suvidhaa Infoserve Ltd is in business of providing digital facility to make payments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company offers a digital platform viz. S-Commerce® to make payments for different services. It provides marketplace technology services to small retail outlets (SMEs and MSMEs)

Company has high debtors of 399 days.
